releaseNotes:
Nokiatis MUC 1.18.0 — the first OFFICIAL release since 1.16.0. Everything the betas shipped, polished into one mandatory update.

LYRICS — REBUILT FROM ZERO
• The v4 engine races every lyric source at once and shows the first correct match immediately: hot in-memory cache, fetching the moment a song starts, word-level sync locked to a 50fps clock, and a 70ms bridge-latency lead so highlighted words land exactly on the beat.
• THE LIVE LYRIC STRIP IN THE PLAYER: the line being sung right now appears as a small quiet line directly under the cover photo — it crossfades between lines like Spotify, never blanks, shows a loading placeholder until lyrics arrive, works for Arabic (RTL) lyrics, and opens the full lyrics screen when tapped.
• Plain-lyrics songs get a graceful preview instead of nothing.

EVERYTHING ROUND STAYS ROUND — FOREVER
• The bottom-bar highlight is a true circle (explicit pixel radius + circular glow bitmap).
• Every header button, play pill and badge is geometrically a circle or capsule: the Settings corner style (Sharp / Soft / Round) can no longer square anything that is meant to be round.
• The header buttons on the Home screen get proper breathing room instead of touching edge to edge.

MADE FOR YOU
• The app learns the artists and albums you play the most and builds your own Made For You section — a Daily Mix per top artist plus your most-played albums.

DOWNLOADS ARE MANUAL, ALWAYS
• Automatic downloading is off for everyone. Smart cache, offline mixtape and liked-song auto-download start OFF. Want a song offline? Press Download yourself.

A SONG IS ALWAYS FOLLOWED BY A SONG
• Podcasts, interviews, leaks, snippets, hour loops and random videos are hard-filtered out of autoplay, radio, recommendations and search. Recommendation searches query songs only, and obvious junk uploads are dropped.

CLOUD & INTELLIGENCE
• Nokiatis Cloud: optional free account that syncs your whole library — likes, saves, playlists, history, bookmarks, follows and listening stats — across every device. True union merge, deletions always win, 100% local-first without an account.
• Nokiatis Intelligence tells you what it remembers about you, and the taste document follows every signed-in device.
• Profile photo and banner, visible share button on every row, download auto-retry with next-song prefetch.

UPDATES THAT ACTUALLY WORK
• System update notifications (bell row + Android notification) for both channels.
• This very release is MANDATORY: the app locks itself with a full-screen update screen until 1.18.0 is installed. Your library, playlists and downloads stay exactly where they are.

ALWAYS
• Installs over your current version with the same Team Nokiatis signature — nothing is lost.
• Signed by Team Nokiatis (CN=Team Nokiatis) — certificate SHA-256 DDA7F001A4DC1DA3A7C39C0A45C81010C0E66AD0A4A952F815E79EE698C1EFC6.

— النسخة الرسمية الأولى منذ 1.16.0: كلمات الأغاني بُنيت من الصفر بمحرك سباق فوري وتزامن كلمة بكلمة على مدار 50 إطارًا في الثانية، وسطر الكلمات الحالي يظهر تحت صورة الغلاف في المشغّل بتنقّل ناعم مثل Spotify ويدعم العربية، وكل الأزرار الدائرية في الهيدر بقت دوائر كاملة مهما غيّرت نمط الزوايا، وقسم صُنع لك يتعلّم أكثر ما تسمع، والتنزيل صار يدويًا بالكامل، والأغنية التالية أغنية دائمًا بلا بودكاست ولا فيديوهات عشوائية، وسحابة نوكياتس تزامن مكتبتك على كل أجهزتك. هذا التحديث إجباري: التطبيق يقفل نفسه حتى تثبيت 1.18.0، ومكتبتك وقوائمك وتنزيلاتك تبقى كما هي تمامًا.
